_schema.id: Stable identifier for this event. Never shown in the calendar UI -- carried through to the generated .ics VEVENT's UID so a later sync can recognize 'this is the same event' across edits.
_schema.title: Event name (ICS SUMMARY).
_schema.notes: Free text: description, contact, price, etc. (ICS DESCRIPTION).
_schema.dayOfWeek: Required when recurrenceType is 'weekly'. RRULE BYDAY code: MO, TU, WE, TH, FR, SA, SU.
_schema.startDate: Required when recurrenceType is 'weekly'. First occurrence, YYYY-MM-DD.
_schema.endDate: Required when recurrenceType is 'weekly'. Last occurrence (RRULE UNTIL bound), YYYY-MM-DD.
